description: You can compute an addition once and use its value twice.

steps.description: The binding pair associates x with the result of (+ 2 3). You compute 5 before evaluating the let body.
The outer binding list contains one pair, (x (+ 2 3)). This makes x available within the body of this let.

steps.question: What value does (* x x) produce with this binding?

steps.description: You see 25 in the output. Both uses of x read the value named by the single binding.

title: Naming a computed value with let
